key_findings: NEW (ORANGE): GAIL-B NCT04099797 (Baylor, Houston) — GD2 CAR-T, Cohort 1 accepts newly diagnosed H3K27-altered DMG ≥4 wk post-RT, age 1–25. Need to verify tumor size <5 cm and concurrent-therapy exclusion.
NEW (WATCH): NCT06221553 — B7-H3 CAR-T for DIPG post-RT (Thailand); thalamic-primary eligibility unclear.
NEW development: ICR London abstract (wuag026.284) — afatinib/neratinib most potent in EGFR exon 20–mutant DMG model; synergy with FGFR inhibitors (preclinical).
All 20 previously tracked trials: status unchanged on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04808245 still active-not-recruiting; rest recruiting/not-yet).
Checked and NOT eligible: TarGeT-SCR NCT05839379 (enrollment window closed 21 days post-RT). No news on BLU-5082; no Japanese/PMDA dordaviprone approval found.
last_run_summary.scan_notes: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 queried for H3K27M / diffuse midline glioma / DIPG / H3 K27-altered / EGFR exon 20 glioma (recruiting + not-yet-recruiting): 72 studies, 54 untracked — reviewed; most are adult-only, observational, RT-technique, recurrence-only, or non-matching targets. Newly posted since last scan: NCT07869524 (IMPT vs IMRT for DIPG — RT already completed, not relevant). Web searches: PubMed/bioRxiv, Neuro-Oncology Pediatrics abstracts, Blueprint (BLU-5082), Jazz/dordaviprone, jRCT (jRCT2051240141 = ACTION Japan arm), Hebrew-language Israeli sources. Not directly crawled this run: EUCTR/CTIS, ChiCTR, CRIS, UMIN, individual Israeli hospital sites.
